text: Given your history of taking haloperidol, have you noticed any involuntary muscle movements, such as grinding your teeth, clenching your jaw, or stiffening of your neck? Additionally, is your body temperature currently very high, and do you feel excessively sweaty or have dry, flushed skin?

text: Do you have an elevated body temperature above 40°C (104°F), and have you noticed any rapid changes in your heart rate or blood pressure? I also need to confirm if you have had any recent trauma or if this started after a dose adjustment of your haloperidol.

text: Past medical history: History of tics, currently on a low dose of haloperidol. Social history: Patient details on social and occupational history not provided.

text: The combination of haloperidol use, rigidity, hyperthermia, and significantly elevated CK strongly suggests Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome.
